lifecycle_hooks.name: init()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Called once when applet is activated. Initialize variables, pre-render, or restore state.

lifecycle_hooks.name: update()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Called every frame (capped ~30-40 FPS). Update game state, physics, non-blocking timers.

lifecycle_hooks.name: draw()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Called after update(). Render frame to Adafruit_SSD1306 display. Do NOT call display.clearDisplay() or display.display() directly; OSManager handles display flush.

lifecycle_hooks.name: cleanup()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Called when switching away from this applet. Save state to Preferences, clear LEDs.

lifecycle_hooks.name: onPrepareSleep()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Called before device enters light/deep sleep.

lifecycle_hooks.name: onActionClick()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Fired when ACTION button is clicked (released under 400ms).

lifecycle_hooks.name: onActionHold()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Fired when ACTION button is held for >= 500ms.

lifecycle_hooks.name: onModeClick()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Fired when MODE button is clicked. Note: In OSManager, clicking MODE typically advances to next applet.

lifecycle_hooks.name: onModeHold()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Fired when MODE button is held for >= 500ms.

lifecycle_hooks.name: onBothHeld()
lifecycle_hooks.description: Fired when both buttons are held simultaneously for >= 800ms.

rules: Never use blocking delay() calls inside update() or draw(). Use non-blocking millis() or micros() delta timers.
Display is 128x64 monochrome (SSD1306). Color constants are SSD1306_WHITE (1) and SSD1306_BLACK (0).
Numbers and scores must ALWAYS be printed as full integers with commas (e.g., 10,000, 12,345), never truncated (no 10k/1M suffixes).
Keep RAM allocations static. Do NOT perform heap allocations (new/malloc) in update() or draw().
Use ThemeFonts::drawCentered(font, text, centerY) or ThemeFonts::measure() for clean typography.
